info.name: Google Cloud Storage JSON BucketAccessControls Objects API

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Returns results in a directory-like mode. Items will contain only objects whose names, aside from the prefix, do not contain delimiter. Objects whose names, aside from the prefix, contain delimiter will have their name truncated after the delimiter, returned in prefixes. Duplicate prefixes are omitted.

params.name: endOffset
params.description: Filter results to objects whose names are lexicographically before endOffset. If startOffset is also set, the objects listed have names between startOffset (inclusive) and endOffset (exclusive).

params.name: includeFoldersAsPrefixes
params.description: Only applicable if delimiter is set to /. If true, will also include folders and managed folders (besides objects) in the returned prefixes.

params.name: includeTrailingDelimiter
params.description: If true, objects that end in exactly one instance of delimiter will have their metadata included in items in addition to prefixes.

params.name: matchGlob
params.description: Filter results to objects and prefixes that match this glob pattern. Supports *, **, ?, and [...] character classes.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of items plus prefixes to return in a single page of responses. The service may return fewer than this value.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A previously-returned page token representing part of the larger set of results to view.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Filter results to objects whose names begin with this prefix.

params.name: projection
params.description: Set of properties to return. Defaults to noAcl.

params.name: softDeleted
params.description: If true, only lists soft-deleted object versions.

params.name: startOffset
params.description: Filter results to objects whose names are lexicographically equal to or after startOffset.

params.name: versions
params.description: If true, lists all versions of an object as distinct results. The default is false.

params.name: fields
params.description: Selector specifying a subset of fields to include in the response. Use for better performance by retrieving only needed fields.

params.name: prettyPrint
params.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks. Default is true. When set to false, can reduce the response payload size.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of objects matching the criteria. The authenticated user must have the storage.objects.list permission for the bucket. Lists objects in a bucket, optionally filtering by a prefix and delimiter to emulate directory listing.

info.name: Google Cloud Storage Get an Object

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: object
params.description: Name of the object. For information about how to URL-encode object names to be path safe, see Encoding URI path parts.

params.name: alt
params.description: Data format for the response. Use json for metadata or media to download the object data.

params.name: generation
params.description: If present, selects a specific revision of this object.

params.name: ifGenerationMatch
params.description: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current generation matches the given value. Setting to 0 makes the operation succeed only if there are no live versions of the object.

params.name: ifGenerationNotMatch
params.description: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current generation does not match the given value.

params.name: ifMetagenerationMatch
params.description: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration matches the given value.

params.name: ifMetagenerationNotMatch
params.description: Makes the operation conditional on whether the object's current metageneration does not match the given value.

params.name: projection
params.description: Set of properties to return. Defaults to noAcl.

params.name: softDeleted
params.description: If true, retrieves the soft-deleted version of the object.

params.name: fields
params.description: Selector specifying a subset of fields to include in the response. Use for better performance by retrieving only needed fields.

params.name: prettyPrint
params.description: Returns response with indentations and line breaks. Default is true. When set to false, can reduce the response payload size.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Retrieves an object or its metadata. The authenticated user must have the storage.objects.get permission for the object. By default, this returns the object metadata. Use alt=media to download the object data.
